agyos_skill.instructions: Technical reference and methodology for verifying whether video media was generated or altered by AI models (specifically Google Flow and Veo), inspecting cryptographic provenance, and conducting digital forensics. | Method | Evidence Strength | Description | |---|---|---| | **Google SynthID Detector** | Strong | Deep-learning embedded digital watermark check across video and audio streams. Identifies Google AI origin. | | **Gemini Verification** | Strong | Analyzes media up to 100MB / 90s for Google AI audio/visual generation markers and segment timestamps. | | **C2PA Content Credentials** | Strong for recorded claims | Cryptographically signed metadata tracking generation models, edits, and tool history. | | **Container & Stream Metadata** | Supporting | Analysis of encoder tags, atom hierarchies, and audio/video stream multiplexing signatures. | | **Visual & Physical Heuristics** | Heuristic clue | Analysis of temporal flicker, anatomical consistency, lighting vectors, and motion physics. | 1. **SynthID Video Detection**: Scan video stream latents for Google's embedded neural watermark. 2. **SynthID Audio Detection**: Independently inspect audio spectrum for embedded generation watermarks. 3. **Segment-Level Verification**: Isolate exact start and end timestamps where synthetic signals test positive. 4. **Visual Watermark Inspection**: Audit corner badges and on-screen generation text indicators. 5. **Watermark Authenticity**: Differentiate authentic machine verification from easily duplicated or removed visual logos. 6. **C2PA Manifest Detection**: Scan file containers for signed Content Credentials headers. 7. **Cryptographic Signature Validation**: Confirm that embedded public-key signatures have not been broken or invalidated. 8. **Certificate Trust Validation**: Trace the signing certificate authority to a recognized credential trust list. 9. **Generation Action History**: Verify whether manifest actions record an initial synthetic generation event. 10. **Editing Action History**: Review documented post-generation edits, crops, and color corrections. 11. **Source Ingredient Inspection**: Review hash links to base reference images or source clips. 12. **Claimed Generator Identification**: Read embedded metadata declaring model variant or software engine. 13. **Original File Acquisition**: Analyze unmodified camera or server downloads rather than recompressed social uploads. 14. **Source-File Checksum**: Compute and record SHA-256 hashes to establish forensic custody. 15. **Project Provenance**: Cross-reference asset IDs against Google Flow studio project databases. 16. **Creator Disclosure**: Audit creator text declarations against platform mandatory disclosure rules. 17. **Verified Upload History**: Locate the earliest public posting date and initial publisher profile.
